title: Marc's TBH

replies.author: lactify
replies.body: I've known for a long time, and it does make me sad that we don't talk a lot, just the occasional "hi." Partly to do with me, apologies. You are very chill though, and you like to put your points across. I respect that. A great player in-game. As I said, wish we could talk more.

replies.body:
SHADOW! You are by far the best YouTuber on Avicus! Honestly, I like your videos, they are chill and funny! You yourself are chill and funny, and like to have banter with me and others. Love your livestreams too. Keep being awesome man!

replies.body: A lot of people didn't like you as Mod, not sure why that was. To me, you were a great moderator, and you are a guy that likes to get his points across. Very decent player in-game.
